alpakicama: alpakica — dim. of alpaka; dat. case pl.
alpakice: alpakica — dim. of alpaka; acc. case pl.
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
ima: imati — to have; ima = «there is, there exists»
iznosu: iznos — sum; u iznosu od — in the amount of
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
jedno: jedan — one, neut.; before the number — «approximately» (jedno tri kilometra)
ko: ko zna — who knows; colloquial abbreviation of kao — «how»
koja: koji — which; fem.; also «which» (koja su to sela)
kojoj: koji; loc. case fem.: o kojoj lokaciji — about which place
mile: do mile volje — as much as one likes
moći: I will be able, to be able
infinitive «to be able»; da li ću moći — will I be able to
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
nećete: you won't be, you won't be able to
ne + hteti; 2nd pers. pl.; nećete moći — you won't be able
niste: negation of auxiliary verba, 2nd pers. pl.
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
odlučite: odlučiti se — to decide, to make up one's mind; 2nd pers. pl.
okviru: okvir — frame; u okviru — within, upon
poseti: posetiti — to visit; 3rd pers. sg.; treba da ih poseti — they are worth visiting
prednje: prednji — front; sa prednje strane — in front
preslatke: preslatka — very cute (pre- + sladak); pl. fem.
prilazi: prilaziti — to approach; se prilazi — they suit
sa: preposition + instr. case; + gen. case — «with, from» (sa mape — from the map)
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
srbiji: Srbija; loc. case: u Srbiji — in Serbia
strane: strana — side; s druge strane — on the other hand
su: biti, 3rd pers. pl.: sela su — villages — this…
treba: trebati — to be needed; treba ti — you need
trofej: trofej — trophy; here a restaurant name
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
ulazu: ulaz — entrance, entry; na ulazu — at the entrance
uočile: uočiti — to notice; past, pl. fem.
vas: short/full form acc. case of vi
videle: videti — to see; past, pl. fem.
volje: volja — will, desire; do mile volje — as much as one likes
što: conjunction «what»; colloquial question «of what, why» (što si se sredio?)
